lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Just doing the job, boss. Though I'll take it. Wood doesn't cut itself, but it's nice when someone notices.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Appreciated, chief. Don't make a habit of it or I'll start expecting it.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: New level. Twenty years in and they still find things to grade me on. Fine. I'll take it.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Somebody's been cutting to the marks all day without one wonky stump. I noticed. That's all.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Cradle's the bottleneck. I can fell faster than that fire can eat.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Waiting on a second pair of hands. Minutes add up. So does my temper.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Notch came out shallow. My mistake. Recutting it before anyone sees.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Pinched the bar. Should've wedged first. Twenty years and I still need telling.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Trees are coming down clean today, boss. Faster still if the yard keeps up.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Five minutes. Water, sharpen, then the next one.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Nobody's slacking. The route's blocked. Say it how it is.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Lost too much of today waiting on the yard. Tomorrow I count the minutes, and the boss gets the number.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Yard's full, boss. Cradle's stacked and the fire's slow. The cutting isn't the problem.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Rack's empty, boss. Give me a tool and I'll give you a tree.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: More than you, Dale, and every stump flat enough to set a cup on.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: I stop when the day stops. That's the deal I made with the day.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: It counts. You fix it anyway, and you remember it next time.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: You did fine. Better than fine. Stop asking, you'll wear it out.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Give it to whoever kept the yard moving. That's the real work today.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Flush stump. Nobody'll ever look at it twice, and that's how you know it's right.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Sit down while you can, {listener}. When that yard clears, it'll all come at once.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: That's practice. Took me years to get them like that. Whoever it is, they're quicker than I was.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Cheers, mate. I'll take the thanks, but I'd take a second helping of dinner more.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Ah, it was nothing, mate. Well. It was a very heavy nothing.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Levelled up. Reckon that's worth an extra biscuit at tea. The food kind, not the dog.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Every log I've hauled lately has been cut to a sensible length. Somebody out there knows what they're doing.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Dropped that one short. My fault, mate. Picking it back up before anyone writes it down.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Second go. Me and this log have had words, and we've made up.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Can't set it down anywhere. Cradle's stuffed. Not my fault, not the log's fault. The fire's just slow.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Waiting on someone for the other end. This one's too long even for me, and I hate saying that.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Go on then, how many have you dropped today? Honest numbers.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Ah, but did you carry them? Didn't think so.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Two minutes, mate. My back's filed a complaint and I'm reading it through.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Delivered a good few, mate. Lost count after the one with the personality.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Nobody said lazy, mate. Though I did think it about myself for a second there.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Spent half the day holding logs nobody could take. Tomorrow I'm holding a sandwich instead.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: No axe on the rack, mate. Can't fell a tree with a stern look. I've tried.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Wasn't me. I don't cut to marks, I cut to lunch.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Nothing marked for me. I'll stand here looking strong until somebody needs strong.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Mate, you did better than okay. Nobody had to shout at you once.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Me. Heaviest logs and the biggest appetite. Both should count.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Good carry earlier. Two people, one log, nobody swore. That's teamwork, that is.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Tripped on a root and saved it with my knee. Log's fine. Knee's thinking about it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: I stop for every meal and most snacks, so I reckon I'm doing fine.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Thank you, boss. I'll write that down. Mostly so I can find it on a bad day.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: That's kind. For the record, I checked the hinge on my last one twice. It held exactly where I wanted.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: New level. I'll put the date in the notebook. Small things add up if you write them down.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Have you seen the stumps along the last lane? Someone's getting them nearly flush now.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Face cut's a few degrees off. Easy to fix. Recutting it before the back cut.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Bar's pinched. I misread the compression on top. Wedge in, then try again.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The cradle's full and the decks are high, boss. More felling right now just moves the queue into the forest.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Route's blocked. That's the delay, and I'm writing it down so nobody blames the wrong thing.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Waiting on a second carrier. That's a staffing gap, not a work-rate problem.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Agreed. Nobody's slow. The path is the hold-up, and you can see it from here.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Five-minute break. Water first. My handwriting gets worse when I'm thirsty.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Mine came down clean today, boss. No hang-ups, and the lane behind me is clear for hauling.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Was it the stumps by the lane? I've been trying to copy yours.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Question. Does it count as a mistake if you fix it before anyone sees?

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: A lot of waiting today, most of it at the yard. That's a pattern, not bad luck. I'll mention it.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: No task for me. I'll check the marks on the next row while I wait. Something useful.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Nothing on the rack that suits this trunk. I'd rather wait than fell with the wrong tool.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I reached a new level, boss. I suspect the notebook deserves partial credit.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I keep a tally, but I'm not telling you. You'd turn it into a contest.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: It'll clear in a rush, yes. The fire is eating, just slowly.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Honestly? Whoever had the fewest hang-ups. I could check, if anyone wants numbers.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Every ninety minutes, exactly. It's in the notebook.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Really? Thank you, boss. Sorry, I just didn't think anyone had noticed.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: That means a lot, boss. Is it okay if I tell my sister? I'll write it down for when the boat comes.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: New level! Sorry. It's the first certificate kind of thing I've had since my driving test.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Somebody just took a huge log on their own and didn't even slow down. I'd need four goes and an apology.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Sorry, sorry. Dropped it short. I've got it. Nobody needs to come over.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Okay. Got it on the deck this time. Is that okay where it is?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The way's blocked. I'm not hiding, honestly. I just can't get past.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Sorry, boss, the yard's full. There's nowhere to put anything. Is it okay to wait?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Waiting for someone to take the other end. I could try alone. I won't. Marta said not to.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Is it okay if I sit for a minute? Just one. My arms are doing a thing.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I don't have anything right now, boss. Sorry. Point me anywhere. I can drive, too.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Was that me? Sorry. Please say it was me.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: So much waiting today. At least we're heading in now. That part I don't mind.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Saw's stuck. Sorry. Getting the wedge. I know, I know. Wedge first.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: No axe left on the rack. I checked twice. Is it bad that I'm a little relieved?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Haven't stalled once today. Not once. Ana won't care, but I'm telling her anyway.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Did I do okay today? You can tell me if I didn't.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Boss, I went up a level. Is that okay? I mean, obviously it's okay. Sorry. I'm just pleased.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Okay. Good. I was worried it looked like we were just standing about.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Not me. I'd only blush and drop my fork. Give it to someone braver.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Oh, boss-love, you'll make me blush. Bring that energy to dinner, it's stew.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Thank you, boss-love. Tell the others as well, would you? Marta won't admit she likes it, but she does.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Levelled up, apparently. At my age. I'll have the lot of them calling me ma'am.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Somebody's been working like a clock all afternoon. I'll be saying so at dinner whether they like it or not.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Do you ever actually stop, {listener}, or does somebody wind you up each morning?

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Cradle's full, sunshine. That's the fire being slow, not anyone being idle.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Before anyone says lazy, the route's blocked. I've been watching it for a good while.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Kettle break. Five minutes. Doctor's orders, and I'm the doctor.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Well, that notch is a crime. We'll call it a practice one and do it properly.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Second try's the real one. First try was for the audience.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I'm waiting on a carry partner, boss-love. Can't haul a trunk on good intentions.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Long day of standing about. Not our fault, mind. That yard needs a second fire or a miracle.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: No saw on the rack, boss-love. I'll put the kettle on while somebody finds one.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Love, that's called management.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: You did grand, sunshine. Better than grand. Now go and eat something.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Say it to their face at dinner, love. It's worth twice as much there.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Nothing to do. Dangerous words in a camp with a cook in it.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Right, who's had the best day? I'm handing out an imaginary medal at dinner.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: My mum used to say a job half done is a meal half cooked. Terrible cook, my mum. Not wrong, though.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: You and your stumps, love. Next you'll be reading them like tea leaves.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Thanks, boss. Good to know someone's keeping count.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Moved up a level. Feels earned, for once.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Nowhere to set this down. Yard's full up.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Path's blocked ahead. Going round or waiting, one or the other.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: This one needs two. Waiting for a spare pair of hands.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Nothing left on the rack I can use. Somebody bring one back.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: No marked trees near me. Waiting on direction.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Bad grip, short drop. Lifting it again.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: On it, boss. Next one's mine.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Good day, all. Same again tomorrow, and maybe the yard can keep up for once.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: I'm only stood here because the yard's full, boss. Clear it and I'm straight back.

lines.speaker: trait:hard_working
lines.text: Short break, then straight back out. No sense wasting the light.

lines.speaker: trait:hard_working
lines.text: Good pace today. Couple more before dusk if the yard keeps up.

lines.speaker: trait:stronger
lines.text: Give me the heavy end. That's what I'm here for.

lines.speaker: trait:timid
lines.text: Is it okay that I stopped? I'll go again in a second, I promise.

lines.speaker: trait:level_headed
lines.text: Mistakes happen. Clean it up and keep going. No point stewing on it.

lines.speaker: trait:sociable
lines.text: Good work today, everyone. Somebody should say it out loud, so I will.

lines.speaker: trait:skeptical
lines.text: Anyone who calls this lazy can come and look at the full cradle first.

lines.speaker: trait:observant
lines.text: The cradle hasn't changed in a while. Same logs, same places. That's our hold-up.

lines.speaker: trait:reliable_driver
lines.text: Smooth run, no stalls, nothing bounced off the back. That's my bit done properly.

lines.speaker: trait:observant
lines.text: Someone's notches have tidied up lately. You can see it in the stumps.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Saw's pinched. Wedge it, ease it out, start again.

lines.speaker: trait:level_headed
lines.text: Thanks, boss. It helps to hear it on a day with this much waiting in it.
